MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t, date_diff('year', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS age
WHERE (age >= 65 AND age = 65) OR (t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans')
RETURN DISTINCT o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t,
  2026 - CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) -
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
      OR (CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age = 65 OR (t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans')
RETURN DISTINCT o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
